newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak FinMin sets two T-bill auctions for Wed.
newsitem.headline: Slovak FinMin sets two T-bill auctions for Wed.

text.p: The Slovak Finance Ministry will auction two unspecified tranches of treasury bills on Wednesday, the National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said on Monday.
The NBS said one tranche of three-week T-bills, and one with a maturity of 40 weeks would be on auction.
In the last successful auction of three-week T-bills on July 3 average yield hit 7.849 percent, down from 8.504 on June 5.
In the last ministry's auction of 40-week T-bills on November 20, the first auction of such a maturity this year, average yield was 10.12 percent.
